<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- Manufacturing Planning & Scheduling â€” Redesign wireframe (Direction A: "Workspace")
     Single-file, standard JavaScript only. Fishbowl Design System tokens.
     Dummy data generated relative to today so the board always looks current. -->
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Production Schedule â€” Fishbowl (Direction A)</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --fb-blue:#137FFD; --fb-blue-accent:#0265D9; --fb-blue-hover:#4499FD; --fb-blue-pressed:#024EA7;
  --fb-negative:#DF0C0C; --fb-neutral:#547089; --fb-success:#188B3F; --fb-warning:#C28028;
  --bg-primary:#FFFFFF; --bg-1:#F9FAFB; --bg-2:#ECF0F4; --bg-3:#E2E8EE; --bg-4:#C1CFDC;
  --menu-bg:#2D3B49; --menu-bg-2:#283640;
  --c-primary:#192229; --c-secondary:#547089; --c-tertiary:#AABBCB; --link:#0265D9;
  --acc-magenta:#E44ECB; --acc-magenta-bg:#FAD6F4; --acc-magenta-con:#6F115F;
  --acc-yellow:#F8C912; --acc-yellow-bg:#FCF38E; --acc-yellow-con:#8F7704;
  --acc-teal:#39B884; --acc-teal-bg:#C5F2EF; --acc-teal-con:#176A4F;
  --font:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
  --mono:'Space Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --r-btn:3px; --r-card:6px; --r-modal:8px; --r-pill:999px;
  --sh1:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06); --sh2:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08); --sh3:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  --border:#E2E8EE; --border-strong:#C1CFDC;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;font-family:var(--font);color:var(--c-primary);background:var(--bg-2);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-size:14px;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bg-4);border-radius:6px;border:2px solid transparent;background-clip:content-box;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--fb-neutral);background-clip:content-box;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}

/* ---------- App shell ---------- */
.app{display:flex;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}
/* Icon rail */
.rail{width:60px;background:var(--menu-bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding:14px 0;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;}
.rail .logo{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4499FD,#137FFD);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.rail-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:9px;border:none;background:transparent;color:#AABBCB;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .15s;}
.rail-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;}
.rail-btn.active{background:var(--fb-blue);color:#fff;}
.rail-btn svg{width:20px;height:20px;}
.rail .spacer{flex:1;}

/* Main column */
.main{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;background:var(--bg-1);}

/* Top bar */
.topbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 22px;flex-shrink:0;}
.topbar-row1{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:60px;}
.title-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0;}
.title-wrap h1{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;line-height:1.1;}
.crumb{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-tertiary);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;}
.top-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.search{position:relative;}
.search input{width:230px;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-btn);
  padding:0 12px 0 34px;font-size:13px;color:var(--c-primary);background:var(--bg-1);outline:none;transition:.15s;}
.search input:focus{border-color:var(--fb-blue);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-focus,0 0 0 3px rgba(19,127,253,.18));}
.search svg{position:absolute;left:10px;top:9px;width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--c-tertiary);}
.btn{height:36px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:var(--r-btn);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background:#fff;color:var(--c-secondary);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.btn:hover{background:var(--bg-1);border-color:var(--fb-neutral);}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
.btn.primary{background:var(--fb-blue);border-color:var(--fb-blue-accent);color:#fff;}
.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--fb-blue-accent);}
.btn.icon{width:36px;padding:0;justify-content:center;}

/* View tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end;height:46px;}
.tab{height:46px;padding:0 16px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--c-secondary);
  font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;position:relative;
  border-bottom:3px solid transparent;transition:.15s;}
.tab:hover{color:var(--c-primary);}
.tab.active{color:var(--fb-blue);border-bottom-color:var(--fb-blue);}
.tab svg{width:17px;height:17px;}
.tab .cnt{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;background:var(--bg-2);color:var(--c-secondary);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 7px;min-width:20px;text-align:center;}
.tab.active .cnt{background:#E3F0FF;color:var(--fb-blue);}

/* Filter chip strip */
.filterbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 22px;background:#fff;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:48px;}
.fchip{height:30px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  background:#fff;color:var(--c-secondary);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:.15s;}
.fchip:hover{background:var(--bg-1);}
.fchip svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--c-tertiary);}
.fchip.on{background:#E3F0FF;border-color:#BFDBFE;color:var(--fb-blue);}
.fchip.on svg{color:var(--fb-blue);}
.fchip-x{margin-left:2px;opacity:.7;}
.filter-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border);margin:0 2px;}
.filterbar .spring{flex:1;}
.grpseg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:var(--r-btn);overflow:hidden;}
.grpseg button{height:30px;padding:0 11px;border:none;background:#fff;color:var(--c-secondary);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-right:1px solid var(--border);}
.grpseg button:last-child{border-right:none;}
.grpseg button.active{background:#E3F0FF;color:var(--fb-blue);}

/* Content */
.content{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:20px 22px;}

/* status pill */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:22px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap;}
.pill .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;}
.pri{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:20px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono);}
.flag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:20px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:4px;
  font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.flag svg{width:12px;height:12px;}
.flag.late{background:#FDE7E7;color:var(--fb-negative);}
.flag.block{background:var(--acc-magenta-bg);color:var(--acc-magenta-con);}
.flag.short{background:var(--acc-yellow-bg);color:var(--acc-yellow-con);}
.flag.cap{background:#FEEAD5;color:var(--fb-warning);}

/* ---------- Dashboard ---------- */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:16px 18px;
  box-shadow:var(--sh1);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.kpi .lbl{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--c-secondary);}
.kpi .val{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:6px;line-height:1;}
.kpi .sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-top:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.kpi .accent{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;}
.dash-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);box-shadow:var(--sh1);overflow:hidden;}
.panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.panel-head h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.panel-head .count{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:var(--fb-negative);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;}
.panel-head .count.warn{background:var(--fb-warning);}
.panel-head .count.info{background:var(--fb-neutral);}
.issue{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);cursor:pointer;transition:.12s;}
.issue:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.issue:hover{background:var(--bg-1);}
.issue .wo{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--link);width:78px;flex-shrink:0;}
.issue .desc{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.issue .desc .t{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.issue .desc .m{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-top:1px;}
.util-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);}
.util-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.util-row .name{width:120px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;flex-shrink:0;}
.util-bar{flex:1;height:20px;background:var(--bg-2);border-radius:var(--r-pill);overflow:hidden;position:relative;}
.util-fill{height:100%;border-radius:var(--r-pill);}
.util-row .pct{width:52px;text-align:right;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono);flex-shrink:0;}

/* ---------- Board / Kanban ---------- */
.board{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;min-height:100%;}
.col{width:288px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--bg-2);border-radius:var(--r-card);display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:100%;}
.col-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 13px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;position:sticky;top:0;}
.col-head .accent{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;}
.col-head .n{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:700;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;}
.col-body{padding:0 8px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;overflow:auto;}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);padding:11px 12px;
  box-shadow:var(--sh1);cursor:pointer;transition:.12s;border-left:4px solid var(--fb-blue);}
.card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.card .row1{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.card .wo{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:var(--link);}
.card .part{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:3px;}
.card .partd{font-size:12px;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-bottom:9px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.card .meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--c-secondary);}
.card .flags{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px;}
.avatar{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-3);color:var(--c-secondary);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}

/* ---------- Table ---------- */
.tbl-wrap{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh1);}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;}
thead th{background:var(--menu-bg);color:#DCE6F1;text-align:left;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:11px 14px;white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;top:0;}
tbody td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);white-space:nowrap;}
tbody tr{cursor:pointer;transition:.1s;}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg-1);}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
td .wo{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;color:var(--link);}
td.num{text-align:right;font-family:var(--mono);}
.rowflags{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;}

/* ---------- Gantt ---------- */
.gantt{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh1);}
.gantt-scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 250px);position:relative;}
.gantt-grid{position:relative;}
.g-headrow{display:flex;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--border);}
.g-labelhead{width:230px;min-width:230px;position:sticky;left:0;z-index:22;background:var(--menu-bg);color:#DCE6F1;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px;}
.g-daycol{width:44px;min-width:44px;border-right:1px solid var(--bg-2);text-align:center;padding:6px 0;}
.g-daycol.wknd{background:#FCFBF4;}
.g-daycol.today{background:#FDECEC;}
.g-daycol .dow{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--c-tertiary);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;}
.g-daycol .dnum{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--c-primary);}
.g-daycol .mon{font-size:9px;color:var(--c-tertiary);font-weight:700;}
.g-grouphead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--bg-1);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:7px 14px;position:sticky;left:0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;z-index:5;}
.g-grouphead .gtag{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 7px;}
.g-grouphead .gc{color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px;}
.g-row{display:flex;position:relative;height:38px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);}
.g-row:hover{background:var(--bg-1);}
.g-rowlabel{width:230px;min-width:230px;position:sticky;left:0;z-index:6;background:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--border);}
.g-row:hover .g-rowlabel{background:var(--bg-1);}
.g-rowlabel .wo{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--link);flex-shrink:0;}
.g-rowlabel .pt{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.g-track{position:relative;flex:1;}
.g-bar{position:absolute;top:7px;height:24px;border-radius:5px;cursor:grab;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding:0 8px;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--sh1);overflow:hidden;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);user-select:none;transition:box-shadow .12s;}
.g-bar:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2);z-index:4;}
.g-bar.dragging{cursor:grabbing;opacity:.85;box-shadow:var(--sh3);z-index:10;}
.g-bar .prog{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}
.g-bar .lbl{position:relative;z-index:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.g-bar.late{border-color:var(--fb-negative);box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--fb-negative);}
.g-bardot{position:absolute;top:11px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;z-index:3;}
.g-today-line{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--fb-negative);z-index:3;opacity:.55;}

/* ---------- Calendar ---------- */
.cal{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh1);}
.cal-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);background:var(--menu-bg);}
.cal-head div{padding:9px;color:#DCE6F1;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center;}
.cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);}
.cal-cell{min-height:118px;border-right:1px solid var(--bg-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);padding:6px;position:relative;}
.cal-cell.oth{background:var(--bg-1);}
.cal-cell.today{background:#FDECEC;}
.cal-cell .dn{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-bottom:5px;}
.cal-cell.today .dn{color:var(--fb-negative);}
.cal-chip{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 6px;
  margin-bottom:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;}
.cal-more{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}

/* ---------- Resource load heatmap ---------- */
.heat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-card);overflow:auto;box-shadow:var(--sh1);
  max-height:calc(100vh - 250px);}
.heat table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;}
.heat th.wc{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:3;text-align:left;min-width:150px;}
.heat th{background:var(--menu-bg);color:#DCE6F1;font-size:10.5px;padding:8px 6px;font-weight:700;
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;}
.heat th.wknd{color:#96b0cc;}
.heat td.wc{position:sticky;left:0;background:#fff;z-index:1;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:0 12px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);}
.heat td.cell{width:54px;height:46px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid #fff;border-bottom:1px solid #fff;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;position:relative;}
.heat .cap-cap{font-size:9px;font-weight:600;opacity:.7;}
.heat-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--c-secondary);}
.heat-legend .sw{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.heat-legend .box{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;}

/* ---------- Detail panel ---------- */
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(25,34,41,.35);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;z-index:40;}
.scrim.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
.detail{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:420px;max-width:92vw;background:#fff;z-index:50;
  box-shadow:var(--sh3);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.detail.on{transform:translateX(0);}
.detail-head{padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.detail-head .top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;}
.detail-head .wo{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--link);}
.detail-head h2{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.detail-head .sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--c-secondary);margin-top:3px;}
.detail-body{padding:18px 20px;overflow:auto;flex:1;}
.dsec{margin-bottom:20px;}
.dsec h4{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--c-tertiary);margin:0 0 10px;}
.dgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px 16px;}
.dfield .k{font-size:11px;color:var(--c-secondary);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px;}
.dfield .v{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}
.close-x{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:var(--r-btn);border:1px solid var(--border);background:#fff;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--c-secondary);}
.close-x:hover{background:var(--bg-1);}
.close-x svg{width:18px;height:18px;}
.dprogress{height:8px;background:var(--bg-2);border-radius:var(--r-pill);overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px;}
.dprogress div{height:100%;background:var(--fb-blue);border-radius:var(--r-pill);}
.alert-box{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:var(--r-card);margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;}
.alert-box svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;}

.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--c-tertiary);padding:60px 20px;font-size:14px;}
.hint{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--c-tertiary);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.hint svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <!-- Icon rail -->
  <nav class="rail">

<script>
/* ============================================================
   DATA MODEL â€” matches reference WO shape, extended for redesign.
   All dates are relative to today so the schedule always looks live.
   ============================================================ */
var MS_DAY = 86400000;
function iso(d){return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);}
function addDays(d,n){var x=new Date(d);x.setDate(x.getDate()+n);return x;}
function parse(s){return new Date(s+'T00:00:00');}
var TODAY = new Date(); TODAY.setHours(0,0,0,0);

var STATUSES = [
  {id:'entered',   name:'Entered',     color:'#547089'},
  {id:'scheduled', name:'Scheduled',   color:'#137FFD'},
  {id:'progress',  name:'In Progress', color:'#C28028'},
  {id:'fulfilled', name:'Fulfilled',   color:'#188B3F'}
];
var CATEGORIES = [
  {id:'fab',  name:'Fabrication',    color:'#137FFD'},
  {id:'mac',  name:'Machining',      color:'#39B884'},
  {id:'asm',  name:'Assembly',       color:'#C28028'},
  {id:'qc',   name:'Quality Control',color:'#E44ECB'}
];
var WORKCENTERS = [
  {id:'laser', name:'Maria Santos',    cat:'fab', cap:16},
  {id:'brake', name:'James Okonkwo',   cat:'fab', cap:16},
  {id:'cnc',   name:'Priya Nair',      cat:'mac', cap:20},
  {id:'weld',  name:'Diego Alvarez',   cat:'asm', cap:16},
  {id:'asmL',  name:'Sarah Chen',      cat:'asm', cap:24},
  {id:'paint', name:'Tom Becker',      cat:'asm', cap:8},
  {id:'qcb',   name:'Aisha Rahman',    cat:'qc',  cap:16}
];
var PARTS = [
  ['FRAME-4400','Welded Base Frame'],['PANEL-210','Side Access Panel'],['BRKT-88','Mounting Bracket'],
  ['SHAFT-12','Drive Shaft Assy'],['HOUS-560','Gearbox Housing'],['DOOR-30','Cabinet Door'],
  ['ARM-77','Articulating Arm'],['PLATE-9','Base Plate'],['GRD-14','Safety Guard'],
  ['MANI-3','Hydraulic Manifold'],['ROLL-201','Conveyor Roller'],['HOP-5','Feed Hopper'],
  ['CLAMP-6','Toggle Clamp'],['TANK-90','Reservoir Tank'],['GEAR-45','Spur Gear Set']
];
var CUSTOMERS = ['Ridgeline Mfg','Apex Robotics','Northwind Foods','Cascade Auto','Delta Systems','Orion Marine','Vertex Tools'];

/* deterministic pseudo-random so the wireframe is stable each load */
var _seed=42; function rnd(){_seed=(_seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return _seed/0x7fffffff;}
function pick(a){return a[Math.floor(rnd()*a.length)];}

var WOS=[];
(function generate(){
  var moGroups=[];
  for(var m=0;m<9;m++){ moGroups.push('MO-'+(1040+m)); }
  var id=2000;
  for(var g=0; g<moGroups.length; g++){
    var mo=moGroups[g];
    var cust=CUSTOMERS[g%CUSTOMERS.length];
    var po='PO-'+(58200+g*7);
    var nWo = 3+Math.floor(rnd()*3);           // 3-5 WOs per MO
    var moStart = -6 + g*2;                     // stagger MOs across the horizon
    var seq = ['fab','mac','asm','qc'];
    var prevFinishOffset = moStart;
    var moDue = moStart + nWo*2 + 3 + Math.floor(rnd()*3);
    for(var w=0; w<nWo; w++){
      id++;
      var catId = seq[w % seq.length];
      var cat = CATEGORIES.filter(function(c){return c.id===catId;})[0];
      var wcs = WORKCENTERS.filter(function(x){return x.cat===catId;});
      var wc = wcs[Math.floor(rnd()*wcs.length)];
      var dur = 1+Math.floor(rnd()*3);
      var startOff = prevFinishOffset + (w===0?0:Math.floor(rnd()*2));
      var finOff = startOff + dur;
      prevFinishOffset = finOff;
      // status derived from position vs today
      var st;
      if(finOff < -1) st='fulfilled';
      else if(startOff <= 0 && finOff >= 0) st='progress';
      else if(startOff <= 2) st='scheduled';
      else st= (rnd()>.5?'scheduled':'entered');
      var part = PARTS[(g*3+w)%PARTS.length];
      var estH = wc.cap*0.35 + Math.floor(rnd()*wc.cap*0.6);  // hours this WO consumes on its WC
      estH = Math.round(estH*dur/ (dur) );
      var pct = st==='fulfilled'?100: st==='progress'? 20+Math.floor(rnd()*55): 0;
      var due = moDue - (nWo-1-w); // later WOs due closer to MO due
      var wo={
        id:id, wo:'WO-'+id, mo:mo, customer:cust, po:po,
        partNum:part[0], partDesc:part[1], qty:20+Math.floor(rnd()*180),
        status:st, category:catId, categoryName:cat.name, categoryColor:cat.color,
        workcenter:wc.id, workcenterName:wc.name,
        start:iso(addDays(TODAY,startOff)), finish:iso(addDays(TODAY,finOff)),
        due:iso(addDays(TODAY,due)), estHours:estH, pct:pct,
        priority: pick(['High','Medium','Medium','Low']),
        blockedBy: w>0? id-1 : null,   // sequential staging dependency within MO
        materialShort:false
      };
      WOS.push(wo);
    }
  }
  // seed a handful of material shortages
  [3,9,14,21].forEach(function(i){ if(WOS[i]) WOS[i].materialShort=true; });
  // force a couple of overdue by pulling due earlier
  [5,12,19].forEach(function(i){ if(WOS[i]&&WOS[i].status!=='fulfilled'){ WOS[i].due=iso(addDays(TODAY,-1-Math.floor(rnd()*2))); }});
})();

/* ---------- issue detection ---------- */
function woById(id){return WOS.filter(function(w){return w.id===id;})[0];}
function isLate(w){ return w.status!=='fulfilled' && parse(w.finish) > parse(w.due); }
function isOverdue(w){ return w.status!=='fulfilled' && parse(w.due) < TODAY; }
function isBlocked(w){
  if(!w.blockedBy) return false;
  var dep=woById(w.blockedBy); if(!dep) return false;
  return dep.status!=='fulfilled' && parse(dep.finish) > parse(w.start); // starts before predecessor finishes
}
function woFlags(w){
  var f=[];
  if(isOverdue(w)||isLate(w)) f.push('late');
  if(isBlocked(w)) f.push('block');
  if(w.materialShort) f.push('short');
  return f;
}

/* ---------- capacity per workcenter per day ---------- */
function capacityMap(list){
  // map wcId -> {dateISO -> hours}
  var map={};
  WORKCENTERS.forEach(function(wc){map[wc.id]={};});
  list.forEach(function(w){
    var s=parse(w.start), f=parse(w.finish);
    var days=Math.max(1,Math.round((f-s)/MS_DAY)+1);
    var perDay=w.estHours/days;
    for(var i=0;i<days;i++){
      var k=iso(addDays(s,i));
      if(!map[w.workcenter]) map[w.workcenter]={};
      map[w.workcenter][k]=(map[w.workcenter][k]||0)+perDay;
    }
  });
  return map;
}

  table:'<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 5h16v14H4zM4 10h16M4 15h16M10 5v14"/>',
  calendar:'<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 6h16v14H4zM4 10h16M8 3v4M16 3v4"/>',

function filtered(){
  var q=state.search.toLowerCase().trim();
  return WOS.filter(function(w){
    if(state.status.length && state.status.indexOf(w.status)<0) return false;
    if(state.category.length && state.category.indexOf(w.category)<0) return false;
    if(q){
      var hay=(w.wo+' '+w.partNum+' '+w.partDesc+' '+w.mo+' '+w.customer+' '+w.po).toLowerCase();

  el.innerHTML=chips+clear+'<span class="spring"></span>'+grp;

  renderAll();
}

}

/* ============================================================
   VIEW: Dashboard
   ============================================================ */
function viewDashboard(){
  var list=filtered();
  var overdue=list.filter(function(w){return isOverdue(w)||isLate(w);});
  var blocked=list.filter(isBlocked);
  var short=list.filter(function(w){return w.materialShort;});
  var progress=list.filter(function(w){return w.status==='progress';});
  var cap=capacityMap(list);
  // bottleneck workcenters: peak day utilization
  var wcUtil=WORKCENTERS.map(function(wc){
    var days=cap[wc.id]||{}, peak=0, sum=0, n=0;
    Object.keys(days).forEach(function(k){ if(parse(k)>=addDays(TODAY,-1)){ peak=Math.max(peak,days[k]); sum+=days[k]; n++; } });
    return {wc:wc, peakPct: Math.round(peak/wc.cap*100), avgPct: n?Math.round(sum/n/wc.cap*100):0};
  }).sort(function(a,b){return b.peakPct-a.peakPct;});
  var bottleneck=wcUtil.filter(function(u){return u.peakPct>100;});

  function utilColor(p){ return p>100?'var(--fb-negative)': p>85?'var(--fb-warning)':'var(--acc-teal)'; }

  var kpis=[
    {lbl:'Open Work Orders', val:list.filter(function(w){return w.status!=='fulfilled';}).length, sub:list.length+' total this horizon', accent:'var(--fb-blue)'},
    {lbl:'Overdue / Late', val:overdue.length, sub:'Past due date', accent:'var(--fb-negative)'},
    {lbl:'Blocked by Dependency', val:blocked.length, sub:'Waiting on upstream WO', accent:'var(--acc-magenta)'},
    {lbl:'Material Shortages', val:short.length, sub:'Missing components', accent:'var(--acc-yellow)'}
  ];
  var khtml=kpis.map(function(k){
    return '<div class="kpi"><div class="accent" style="background:'+k.accent+'"></div>'+
      '<div class="lbl">'+k.lbl+'</div><div class="val" style="color:'+k.accent+'">'+k.val+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sub">'+k.sub+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');

  function issueRows(arr,meta){
    if(!arr.length) return '<div class="empty" style="padding:28px">Nothing here â€” all clear.</div>';
    return arr.slice(0,6).map(function(w){
      return '<div class="issue" onclick="openDetail('+w.id+')">'+
        '<span class="wo">'+w.wo+'</span>'+
        '<div class="desc"><div class="t">'+esc(w.partDesc)+'</div><div class="m">'+w.mo+' Â· '+w.customer+' Â· '+meta(w)+'</div></div>'+
        pillHTML(w.status)+'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  return '<div class="kpis">'+khtml+'</div>'+
   '<div class="dash-grid">'+
     '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px">'+
       '<div class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><h3><svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--fb-negative)" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9L1.8 18a2 2 0 001.7 3h17a2 2 0 001.7-3L14.7 3.9a2 2 0 00-3.4 0z"/></svg>Overdue & Late</h3><span class="count">'+overdue.length+'</span></div>'+
         issueRows(overdue,function(w){return 'due '+fmtDate(w.due);})+'</div>'+
       '<div class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><h3><svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--acc-magenta)" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11z"/></svg>Blocked by Dependency</h3><span class="count" style="background:var(--acc-magenta)">'+blocked.length+'</span></div>'+
         issueRows(blocked,function(w){var d=woById(w.blockedBy);return 'waiting on '+(d?d.wo:'â€”');})+'</div>'+
     '</div>'+
     '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px">'+
       '<div class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><h3><svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--fb-warning)" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3 12h4l3 8 4-16 3 8h4"/></svg>Workcenter Load â€” next 7 days peak</h3><span class="count '+(bottleneck.length?'warn':'info')+'">'+(bottleneck.length||'OK')+'</span></div>'+
         wcUtil.slice(0,7).map(function(u){
           var p=Math.min(u.peakPct,160);
           return '<div class="util-row"><span class="name">'+u.wc.name+'</span>'+
             '<div class="util-bar"><div class="util-fill" style="width:'+Math.min(p,100)+'%;background:'+utilColor(u.peakPct)+'"></div>'+
             (u.peakPct>100?'<div style="position:absolute;right:4px;top:2px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:'+utilColor(u.peakPct)+'">OVER</div>':'')+'</div>'+
             '<span class="pct" style="color:'+utilColor(u.peakPct)+'">'+u.peakPct+'%</span></div>';
         }).join('')+'</div>'+
       '<div class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><h3><svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="var(--acc-yellow-con)" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10"/></svg>Material Shortages</h3><span class="count warn">'+short.length+'</span></div>'+
         issueRows(short,function(w){return 'components short';})+'</div>'+

  var h=hex.replace('#','');var r=parseInt(h.substr(0,2),16),g=parseInt(h.substr(2,2),16),b=parseInt(h.substr(4,2),16);
  return 'rgba('+r+','+g+','+b+','+a+')';
}
function flagsHTML(w){

/* visual drag-to-reschedule on gantt bars */
function wireGantt(){
  var bars=document.querySelectorAll('.g-bar');
  bars.forEach(function(bar){
    var startX,origLeft,moved;
    bar.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
      e.preventDefault(); moved=false;
      startX=e.clientX; origLeft=parseFloat(bar.style.left);
      bar.classList.add('dragging');
      function mv(ev){
        var dx=ev.clientX-startX;
        if(Math.abs(dx)>3) moved=true;
        var snapped=Math.round((origLeft+dx)/DAYW)*DAYW;
        bar.style.left=Math.max(0,snapped)+'px';
      }
      function up(){
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove',mv);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup',up);
        bar.classList.remove('dragging');
        if(moved){ // update dummy dates so it persists within the session
          var id=+bar.getAttribute('data-id'); var w=woById(id);
          var newIdx=Math.round(parseFloat(bar.style.left)/DAYW);
          var s=parse(w.start),f=parse(w.finish);
          var span=Math.round((f-s)/MS_DAY);
          var newStart=addDays(TODAY,GANTT_START+newIdx);
          w.start=iso(newStart); w.finish=iso(addDays(newStart,span));
          setTimeout(function(){ renderContent(); }, 60);
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener('mousemove',mv);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup',up);
    });
    // suppress click after drag
    bar.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(bar.classList.contains('__moved')){e.stopPropagation();} },true);
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(drawDeps);
}
